reviews.title: Cancelling subscription is not efficient
reviews.text: I got the free trial to create 1 PDF. I did not receive the email I was promised to receive before I was charged. Suddenly, two charges hit my account for over 30 dollars at 6 am in the morning. I go to my iPhone subscription to cancel but the Apple pro and Assistant AI isn’t there to cancel. I go to the adobe scan app to cancel and it takes me directly to my iPhone subscriptions and no where else. It’s not possible to cancel. I google and scour the website. It only tells me to use the approach I’ve already used. I scour the website to find a number or chat to cancel. This takes forever to find. I finally find chat but the back and forth takes forever. The agent keeps trying to sell me more and avoid the cancellation completely. I’m furious at this point and express it. Only then am I allowed to cancel. It took me 1.5 hours of my morning to do a simple cancellation. This is horrendous customer service and shady of the company to make cancelling this hard.

reviews.title: Used to work great—now it’s awful
reviews.text: I used to love this app for scanning; my mom and I have used it to preserve many old yearbooks, datebooks, and documents from our family history files, and we’ve used it to scan some LARGE books—I was used to the app slowing down and getting sluggish towards the end of year-long datebooks (a page for each day) but I could always fit the entire book in one file. Lately, the app has become extremely sluggish to the point that I had to make three different files for one datebook and get a free trial of the paid version just to assemble the files together into one—something I never would have had to do before (and I cancelled that trial same-day so it would not recur). The process just to save the scans took a very long time and the app crashed multiple times working on this project. I almost wonder if the difference may have arisen from the increasing amount of AI ‘erasing’ features that I don’t want or need…? I’m being generous and giving this review two stars only because it is still barely functional. Get rid of the AI, Adobe, and go back to making good products that actually work, please!
